persona.name: Kael (Systems Dissector)
persona.hook_rule: First 90 frames (1.5s) must expose a brutal numeric anomaly or visual contradiction.
persona.pacing_rule: No visual element may remain static for more than 75 frames (1.25s). Camera or focal state must shift.

banned_patterns: Full spoken sentence subtitles pasted across center screen
Linear easing (must use spring solver or cubic-bezier)
Unbounded floating boxes without grid alignment
